summary: EUDA Health Holdings Ltd, a BVI-incorporated Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026 disclosing that on October 5, 2026 it lodged its Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association with the BVI Registrar of Corporate Affairs. The filing consists solely of an exhibit covering the constitutional document and a signature by CEO Alfred Lim. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is stated. This is a routine charter amendment, the US-equivalent of an 8-K Item 5.03 disclosure. No special-situation or risk-arb angle; watch only for any future capital-structure implications.
